data.title: WinVest Extends Business Combination Deadline with Strong Support
data.description:
WinVest Corp ( (WINV) ) has shared an update.

At a special meeting on September 15, 2026, WinVest Corp stockholders approved amendments to extend both the liquidation date of its trust account and the termination date for completing a business combination from September 17, 2026 to October 17, 2026, with the ability to further extend monthly up to March 17, 2027 without additional stockholder votes. On September 16 and 18, 2026, the company executed a trust agreement amendment, issued a $180,000 unsecured, non-interest-bearing promissory note to its sponsor to fund potential monthly extensions, and filed a charter amendment in Delaware, after unanimous stockholder approval with approximately 98.32% of voting power present, underscoring strong investor support for continuing its search for a merger partner.

These actions collectively extend WinVest’s runway to close an initial business combination by up to six months beyond the original deadline, potentially preserving value for stockholders by avoiding immediate liquidation of the trust account. The sponsor-funded structure, whereby extension payments are deposited into the trust while the note is repayable only from funds outside the trust if no merger occurs, shifts some risk to the sponsor and signals confidence in the company’s ability to secure a suitable transaction.
